predictions.headline: Rangers' perfect home start points to a Madison Square Garden moneyline
predictions.text: Madison Square Garden has been a fortress: New York is 6-0-0 at home and 7-3-1 overall, with 33 goals for and only 24 against in 11 starts. The last ten games read 7-2-1 and the New York Rangers head in off a win. Los Angeles, by contrast, is 1-4-2 and has managed 17 goals in seven games, going 1-1-2 on the road. With an 11-point cushion in the standings, the New York Rangers moneyline at our fair 1.45 (-222), a 68.9% probability, is the pick.

predictions.headline: Carolina's 42-goal attack meets a Columbus side without a road win
predictions.text: Carolina's 42 goals are the standout number here: 8-2-1 for 17 points, with a last-ten line of 8-2-0. Oddly for a team this strong, the Hurricanes have done more damage away (6-1-0) than at home (2-1-1), though they arrive off a win. Columbus has 20 goals in eight games, a 3-5-0 record, an 0-2-0 road mark and two straight defeats. That points to the Carolina Hurricanes moneyline at 1.42 (-238), which we price at 70.3%.

predictions.headline: Boston's plus-14 goal difference is the edge against a winless road team
predictions.text: Boston has scored 36 and conceded 22 in building a 7-2-1 record, and its 3-1-0 home mark includes a last outing that needed overtime. Chicago's numbers go the other way: 21 goals for, 36 against, 3-6-0 overall, 0-4-0 on the road and a one-game losing streak. The plus-14 versus minus-15 goal difference is the clearest split on the card, so the Boston Bruins moneyline is the selection at our fair 1.40 (-250), a 71.3% probability.
